tests.name: activity_log_context_exposes_attempt_scoped_artifact_directory
tests.description: Activity and Devin logs share an exposed attempt-scoped artifact directory
tests.arrange: Configure a temporary log root and explicit Cadence Activity info
tests.act: Enter activity_log_context and request the artifact directory
tests.assert: The directory contains activity.log and devin.log and includes the Activity attempt

tests.name: activity_artifact_directory_is_none_without_activity_context
tests.description: Callers outside Cadence Activity logging do not receive a durable artifact path
tests.arrange: Use no Activity context and an activity_log_context with no resolvable Activity info
tests.assert: The result is None before, during, and after the fallback context

tests.name: activity_artifact_directory_sanitizes_path_unsafe_identifiers
tests.description: Workflow, run, and Activity identifiers cannot escape the configured log root
tests.arrange: Provide identifiers containing traversal segments, separators, dots, and unicode
tests.act: Enter activity_log_context and request the artifact directory
tests.assert: Every derived component is sanitized and the resolved directory remains below the log root

tests.name: activity_artifact_directories_isolate_activities_and_retry_attempts
tests.description: Concurrent Activity identities and retry attempts never select the same artifact directory
tests.arrange: Create Activity info values that vary by Activity id and attempt within one workflow run
tests.act: Resolve an artifact directory for each Activity context
tests.assert: All resulting directories are distinct and each retains its own log files
